notes.title: Now also available for Mac!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42163198/b07576c107d31d166118c2d7b99e0416e442bca3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Now on Mac![/h1]

Yes, Robotherapy is also now available for the machines called Macintosh! Are they still called that? What a strange name!

It's also [u]on sale[/u]! A whole [b]50% off[/b]!

([i]wait, that's not whole, that's literally half![/i])

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895970/Robotherapy/

Also check out my new narrative game, [b]Firelore: Short Tales[/b] — also available on Mac!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289270/Firelore_Short_Tales/
